brief:
Israeli media outlets have accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of deliberately escalating tensions with Iran ahead of upcoming elections, according to a Middle East Eye press review. The allegations suggest political calculation behind military posturing rather than security necessity.

The review also noted that women's representation is projected to decline in the next Knesset, while tens of thousands of Israelis abroad face representation challenges in the electoral process.
dek: Israeli press review: Netanyahu accused of pushing Iran escalation ahead of election Submitted by Nadav Rapaport on Mon, 10/26/2026 - 12:47 Meanwhile, women’s representation is set to fall in the next Knesset, and tens of thousands of Israelis living abroad…
title: Israeli media accuses Netanyahu of escalating Iran tensions before election
